name: studio_subtask
description: Do one independent part of a large job (one story of a set, one module of a unit, the pack a scene needs) on a thread of its own, as a sub-task: it starts fresh with only your brief (the notebook and the job's thread aren't in it), reads and publishes with the same tools, and returns what it published in a line or two. Use it when a job has several parts that don't need each other's details, so this thread stays short; a small job needs none. At most six a job; a sub-task can't start another.

title.description: The part's name, shown in the job's progress.

brief.description: Everything the part needs: what to write and publish, the ids it must use or avoid, the level, the mistake patterns.
